text_zh: 重庆体育博物馆的常规散客基本参观可凭有效证件免预约；通常周一闭馆，国家法定节假日除外。仍可选择预约，最多可提前7天；这不是必须提前7天的要求。团队、特展和临时活动另查。
text_en: For regular individual general admission, Chongqing Sports Museum allows visits with a valid ID without mandatory booking. It normally closes on Mondays except statutory public holidays. Optional reservations may be made up to seven days ahead; this is not a seven-day minimum. Check group, special-exhibition and temporary-event arrangements separately.
